name: On Edge
description: "On Edge" finds Greg Porn leaning into tension — a dangerous, late-night underground hip hop record that lives up to its title. DistroKid-verified under Cumulative Web Inc, the track trades anthem-sized hooks for something more wire-taut: atmospheric production, crisp hi-hats, and a vocal performance that sounds one bar away from snapping. Greg Porn raps with an introspective edge here, turning street narrative inward — the paranoia and pressure that come with ambition, rendered without flinching. The mix is lean and menacing, an 808-driven low end pressing against a sparse, nocturnal arrangement, with trap drums that hit like a pulse running too fast. Within Greg Porn's CWI run — alongside "Pay Yourself" and the unreleased "Unholy Hunter" — "On Edge" is the uneasy middle chapter: aggressive but controlled, hypnotic but never comfortable. It is the sound of an artist who knows exactly how close to the line he is standing, and keeps walking anyway.
